BiblicalUsage: mappâlâh is a ruin, something fallen that stays fallen. In Isaiah 17:1 Damascus shall be taken away from being a city and become a ruinous heap, and in Isaiah 25:2 a defenced city is made a ruin that shall never be built. In Isaiah 23:13 the Assyrian brings Tyre's palaces to ruin. The word is the end of proud cities.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mappâlâh shows me that no city stands for ever against God. I hold that the ruins of Damascus and Tyre preach what pride refuses to hear, and that only God's city endures.
